name: Com chay
summary: Cơm cháy is the crisp rice cake Ninh Bình sends home. The 15 February 2023 culture page says the rice is gạo tám thơm from Hải Hậu, which that page still calls tỉnh Nam Định, cooked in a thick iron pot until the edge scorches.
origin: Ninh Bình, as a gift and a table dish. The 2023 culture page still places the rice in Hải Hậu, tỉnh Nam Định.
howToEat: Break the cake. The same page says you eat it with ruốc, or as cơm cháy sốt dê at the goat table.
The photograph is the dry cake on a plate.
where: The roads out toward Tràng An, Hoa Lư, and Bái Đính, and as a packaged gift. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Com chay — Ninh Binh crisp rice
seoDescription: Crisp rice from the Ninh Bình culture page: Hải Hậu gạo tám thơm, still called Nam Định on that page, eaten with ruốc or goat sauce.
